en: This is a colorized historical postcard showing a military parade or inspection. It features rows of uniformed soldiers in blue uniforms with red accents, standing in formation. There are officers on horseback, and in the background, there are trees and grand buildings typical of central European architecture. The words 'Theresienstadt.' and 'Paradeausrückung.' are printed at the top in red type.
